meta_description:
194K likes, 4,777 comments - anunaysood on October 9, 2026: "Ivaan turned one today. This is the only picture we have of the two of them together, and Anunay, would have wanted you all to be part of this day! 

To everyone who has stayed with Anunay’s page, Thank you. It has been very quiet here ever since he left us and it hasn’t been easy…he is missed every single day, every second. We, his sisters, will be sharing memories of him here from time to time. 

Please keep him in your hearts. Share your own stories of him in the comments. He would have loved that.".
